## Original path
D:\click here\2代目\experiments

## Description
This folder contains the main robustness and perturbation outputs generated from the benchmark-aggregation experiments. It includes summary tables retained in the repository and larger event-level or minute-level experimental files kept outside the public GitHub repository.

## Time range
Primarily 2021–2022 paper-sample outputs based on the synchronized BTCUSD minute panel.

## Key variables
Typical experimental fields include:
- shock definition
- delta_w / weight factor
- pivot change indicators
- shift statistics for VWAP and LWMP
- concentration-bin summaries
- weight-concentration diagnostics

## Generated by
- run_robustness_experiments.py
- weight_concentration_check.py
- related experiment and summary scripts in `src/experiments/`

## Used in paper
These files support the robustness layer referenced in Section 5 of the main paper and in Appendices A–E, including threshold robustness, perturbation summaries, and concentration-based checks. 

## File status
Large sample-level outputs such as `*_shift_samples` and minute-level concentration files are not included in the GitHub repository because of file-size constraints. Summary tables are represented in the repository’s output folders.

## Actual storage location
Currently stored locally.

## Notes
Users who wish to inspect the full experimental sample files should reconstruct them from the released code pipeline or request access to the large local outputs if a public archival location is added later.
